platforms.name: Modal
platforms.blurb: Serverless Python — wrap vLLM in @app.cls and ship with `modal deploy`

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.blurb: Managed container — BYO Docker image with the SageMaker entrypoint
platforms.install:
# Dockerfile
FROM vllm/vllm-openai:latest
COPY sagemaker-entrypoint.sh /app/
RUN chmod +x /app/sagemaker-entrypoint.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/sagemaker-entrypoint.sh"]
